rows.title: D 初步研究报告（1 个研究问题）

sections.heading: 000000. 三维 l^p 球 B_p^3（1≤p≤∞）的中心截面最大面积：求 A_max(p)=max{area(B_p^3∩H): H 过原点的平面}，并给出取到最大的平面法向等价类与 A_max(p) 的分段表达式。可判定形式：(i) 面积只依赖法向在带符号坐标置换群（48 阶超八面体群）下的等价类 ⇒ 基本域 0≤a≤b≤c，三类候选方向为坐标向 (1,0,0)、面对角向 (1,1,0)/√2、体对角向 (1,1,1)/√3；(ii) 最大方向按 p 三段：p<2 坐标向、2<p<p* 体对角向、p>p* 面对角向（p=2 时全方向面积均为 π，退化不唯一）；(iii) p* 是 A_diag(p)=A_face(p) 在 p>2 上的唯一解，数值读数 p*=4.998215596841106（E 的二分，区间 (4,5) 内唯一变号）；(iv) 分段表达式：A_coord(p)=4Γ(1+1/p)^2/Γ(1+2/p)，A_face(p)=2^(1/2-1/p)·A_coord(p)，A_diag(p)=3√3∫_0^1 (1+t^p+(1-t)^p)^(-2/p) dt。判它有假的方式：在任意 p 上展示一个法向(n)（归一化、a≤b≤c 基本域）使 area 严格大于上述三个闭式在该 p 的最大值；或证明 A_diag/A_coord 在 p<2 有 >1 的点；或展示 A_diag=A_face 在 p>2 有第二个解。
sections.body: 无法基于现有证据包判断该数学结论成立与否；只能给出“未验证/证据不足”的初步结论，置信度低。

rows.title: Maximal-area central sections of the three-dimensional l_p ball

sections.heading: 1 Introduction
sections.body: Ball determined the maximal hyperplane section of the cube. The present note treats the three-dimensional l_p ball B_p^3 and asks which central section has maximal area, comparing the coordinate, body-diagonal and face-diagonal normal directions.

sections.heading: 2 Definitions and notation
sections.body: Write B_p^3 = {(x,y,z) : |x|^p+|y|^p+|z|^p <= 1} and let A_p(n) be the two-dimensional Lebesgue area of B_p^3 intersected with the plane through the origin with unit normal n. The candidate areas are A_coord(p) = A_p(e_3), A_diag(p) = A_p((1,1,1)/sqrt(3)) and A_face(p) = A_p((1,1,0)/sqrt(2)).

sections.heading: 3 Main results
sections.body: The integral representation and the two closed forms are recorded, then the two transition parameters are located: p = 2 where the coordinate and body-diagonal areas coincide, and p-star = 4.998215596862 where the body-diagonal and face-diagonal areas coincide. The three-regime description is stated as a numerically supported conjecture.

sections.heading: 4 Discussion and open problems
sections.body: The scans support a three-regime picture but do not exclude intermediate maximizing normals; an analytic treatment of the ordered absolute-value domain and a sharp value of p-star remain open.

claims.text: Ball determined the largest hyperplane section of the unit cube: among all hyperplane sections of the cube, a section perpendicular to 2^{-1/2}(1,1,0,...,0) has the largest volume.
Koenig studies the largest hyperplane sections of the unit ball of l_p^n for p > 2 and shows that the cube-slicing phenomenon persists for suitable normals when p is large.

The literature on plane sections of the unit ball of l_p, on critical central sections of the cube and on extremal sections of subspaces of l_p supplies the general circle of questions addressed by the computations reported here.

For every p in [1,infinity) and every unit vector n, the area A_p(n) of the central section B_p^3 intersected with the plane n^perp depends only on that plane, is invariant under signed coordinate permutations, and equals (1/2) integral_0^{2 pi} ||cos(psi) u + sin(psi) v||_p^{-2} dpsi for any orthonormal basis {u,v} of n^perp.
claims.disclaimer: 逐行审阅过的证明，未经机器检查
数值交叉验证，不构成证明
claims.text: For every p in [1,infinity) the coordinate normal gives A_coord(p) = 4 Gamma(1+1/p)^2 / Gamma(1+2/p); this equals pi at p = 2 and tends to 4 as p tends to infinity, and the quadrature kernel reproduces these values to relative deviation at most 1e-13.

claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明
claims.text: For every p in [1,infinity), the central plane section of the unit ball of l_p^3 by the hyperplane with face-diagonal normal (1,1,0)/sqrt(2) has area A_face(p) = 2^{1/2-1/p} * 4 Gamma(1+1/p)^2 / Gamma(1+2/p), with A_face(1) = sqrt(2), A_face(2) = pi and A_face(p) tending to 4 sqrt(2); moreover A_face(p) < A_coord(p) exactly when p < 2, with equality at p = 2 and the reverse inequality for p > 2.

claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明
claims.text: If a unit normal n has at least one vanishing coordinate, then A_p(n) = C_p (sum over j not equal i of |n_j|^p)^{-1/p} with C_p = 4 Gamma(1+1/p)^2 / Gamma(1+2/p); consequently for 1 <= p < 2 every such normal gives A_p(n) <= C_p with equality only at coordinate normals, and for p > 2 the same expression holds with the reverse inequality.

claims.disclaimer: 逐行审阅过的证明，未经机器检查
claims.text: For every p in [1,infinity) the body-diagonal section area satisfies A_diag(p) = (3/4) integral_0^{2 pi} (|cos(theta - pi/6)|^p + |cos(theta + pi/6)|^p + |sin theta|^p)^{-2/p} d theta; moreover A_diag(1) = 3 sqrt(3)/4, A_diag(2) = pi, the limit of A_diag(p) as p tends to infinity is 3 sqrt(3), and p maps to A_diag(p) is continuous on [1,infinity).

claims.disclaimer: 逐行审阅过的证明，未经机器检查
claims.text: The difference Delta(p) = A_face(p) - A_diag(p) is continuous on [1,infinity), Delta(2) = 0, Delta(1) = sqrt(2) - 3 sqrt(3)/4 > 0 and the limit of Delta(p) as p tends to infinity is 4 sqrt(2) - 3 sqrt(3) > 0; hence there is P0 in [1,infinity) with A_face(p) > A_diag(p) for every p >= P0.

claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明
claims.text: Numerically supported strong conjecture, not established here: for the twelve values p in {1.05,1.1,1.2,1.5,2,2.5,3,4,5,8,16,1000} the largest central section of B_p^3 is attained at the coordinate normal when p < 2, at the body-diagonal normal when 2 < p < p-star and at the face-diagonal normal when p > p-star, where p-star = 4.998215596862.

claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明
claims.text: Two transition parameters separate the three regimes in the scanned range: the ratio A_diag/A_coord crosses 1 exactly at p = 2, and A_diag and A_face cross at p-star = 4.998215596862 located by bisection with six rounds of local refinement; along the boundary arcs of normals of the form (0,1,t) and (1,1,t) the section area is largest at an endpoint t in {0,1,infinity}, and any strictly intermediate t gives a strictly smaller value for p not equal to 2.

The quadrature kernel used for all scans was validated independently: it returns pi for every central section at p = 2 with deviation at most 1e-15, matches the octahedron clipping values at p = 1, approaches the cube values 4, 3 sqrt(3) and 4 sqrt(2) at p = 1000, reproduces 4 Gamma(1+1/p)^2 / Gamma(1+2/p) to relative deviation at most 1e-13, and is invariant under rotation of the plane basis to 1e-12.
claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明

claims.text: The three-regime picture obtained here is a three-dimensional finite-p counterpart of the cube-slicing result of Ball and of the p > 2 analysis of Koenig: as p tends to infinity the three candidate areas tend to 4, 3 sqrt(3) and 4 sqrt(2), so the face-diagonal normal is the largest in the limit, in agreement with the cube case.
claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明

claims.text: Limitation: no analytic argument is offered here for the absence of intermediate maximizing normals; the evidence is a boundary-arc scan together with a grid in the ordered absolute-value domain 0 <= a <= b <= c, so a normal with three distinct non-zero coordinates lying outside the scanned grid is not excluded by these computations.
claims.disclaimer: 数值交叉验证，不构成证明

open_problems: Give an analytic argument that no normal with three distinct non-zero coordinates maximizes the section area for any p in [1,infinity).
Determine p-star in closed form, or prove that it is transcendental, and prove that the crossing of A_diag and A_face is unique.
